profile.description:
Grok Imagine Image 2.0 generates images from a text prompt and edits up to five attached images from a plain-language instruction, with selectable quality, 1K or 2K output, and fifteen aspect ratios.

With more than one image, refer to them in your prompt as IMAGE_0, IMAGE_1, and so on.

This bot supports optional parameters for additional customization.

**Grok Imagine Image 2 Pricing**

Text-to-image and image editing. Billed per image generated, by quality and resolution, plus a per-image fee for each image you attach. Text-to-image attaches no images, so it has no image fee.
